method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Some people's speech impresses you and they call God to witness what is in their hearts, yet they are the fiercest in a quarrel; they go about the earth to corrupt it and destroy crops and offspring; pride takes hold of them when told to be mindful of God.
ideas: A smooth-talking man at a podium with a hand on his heart and the other fist clenched behind
A man walking through a ripe wheat field leaving a path of trampled stalks
A man turns away from an offered hand with his chin high
A bulldozer across an orchard

sections.meaning: Some sell themselves seeking to please God; enter into peace all together and do not follow Satan's footsteps.
ideas: A man sells his violin and puts the money in a donation jar
A man carries a heavy sack of grain to a neighbor's house in the rain
People of every kind walking together through one wide gate into a sunlit meadow

sections.meaning: They wait for nothing but God to come in canopies of clouds; the life of this world is made attractive to those who disbelieve; people were one community, then differed out of resentment.
ideas: A crowd in a dry field staring up at towering clouds with hands shading their eyes
A glittering shop window of watches and jewelry with a man staring through the glass
One enormous murmuration of starlings over a field
A ring of people holding hands in a meadow

sections.meaning: Hardship shakes them until they cry 'When is God's aid?' and the answer is that his aid is near; spend on those in need; you may hate what is good for you and love what is bad for you.
ideas: People on a flooded rooftop see a rescue boat come round the corner
A hiker in a blizzard sees the light of a hut near
Five different open hands each reaching for a loaf of bread
A child grimaces at bitter medicine on a spoon with a candy jar beside her

sections.meaning: Persecution is graver than killing; deeds of those who turn back come to nothing; those who emigrate and strive hope for mercy; wine and gambling have great sin and some benefit; setting things right for orphans is good, for they are your brothers.
ideas: A sand sculpture washed away by the tide at sunset
A boat of people crossing a calm sea at dawn toward a far shore
A pair of dice beside an empty wine glass and crumpled bills
A man and an orphan boy fixing a bicycle together
An orphan boy at the family table shoulder to shoulder with the children
